an5.72:1.1: pañcime bhikkhave dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā cetovimuttiphalā ca honti cetovimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca paññāvimuttiphalā ca honti paññāvimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca
an5.72:1.3: aniccasaññā anicce dukkhasaññā dukkhe anattasaññā pahānasaññā virāgasaññā
an5.72:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā cetovimuttiphalā ca honti cetovimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca paññāvimuttiphalā ca honti paññāvimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca
an5.72:1.5: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu cetovimutto ca honti paññāvimutto ca
an5.72:1.6: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho itipi saṃkiṇṇaparikkho itipi abbuḷhesiko itipi niraggaḷo itipi ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto itipi.
an5.72:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno avijjā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃ katā āyatiṃanuppādadhammā
an5.72:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho hoti.
an5.72:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno ponobbhaviko jātisaṃsāro pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṃ kato āyatiṃanuppādadhammo
an5.72:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu saṃkiṇṇaparikkho hoti.
an5.72:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno taṇhā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃ katā āyatiṃanuppādadhammā
an5.72:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu abbuḷhesiko hoti.
an5.72:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni pahīnāni honti ucchinnamūlāni tālāvatthukatāni anabhāvaṃ katāni āyatiṃanuppādadhammāni
an5.72:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu niraggaḷo hoti.
an5.72:6.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto hoti
an5.72:6.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno asmimāno pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṃ kato āyatiṃanuppādadhammo
an5.72:6.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto hotīti.
